title: Legs & Core Burn
description: Dynamic legs with goblet squats and curtsy lunges followed by targeted core work for thighs and abs

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.instructions: Step up and down off a step, alternating legs

exercises.name: Goblet squat (no weight)
exercises.instructions: Hands clasped in front of the chest, descend deep

exercises.name: Curtsy lunges
exercises.instructions: Cross the back leg diagonally behind

exercises.name: Good morning
exercises.instructions: Hands behind the head, hinge the torso forward keeping the back straight

exercises.name: Marching glute bridge
exercises.instructions: In a bridge, alternate lifting one leg then the other like marching

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs up, extend opposite arm and leg alternating

exercises.name: Russian twists
exercises.instructions: Seated, feet lifted, rotate torso left and right

exercises.name: Toe touches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs vertical, touch the feet with the hands

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
